docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A textbook of engineering acoustics: the basics of waves and vibration, lumped-element and electro-acoustic models, transducers such as loudspeakers and microphones, ducts and mufflers, room acoustics and noise.

From Wikibooks · CC BY-SA 4.0

Engineering Acoustics, a Wikibooks textbook, by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikibooks when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Modified: converted to this format.
